query:
WITH current AS (
                SELECT id, rank
                FROM users
                WHERE id IN ($1, $2)
                FOR UPDATE
            )
            UPDATE users u
            SET rank = u.rank + 32 * (
                CASE 
                    WHEN u.id = $1 AND $3 = 'white_win' THEN 1
                    WHEN u.id = $2 AND $3 = 'black_win' THEN 1
                    WHEN $3 = 'draw' THEN 0.5
                    ELSE 0
                END
                -
                (
                    1.0 / (
                        1 + POWER(10,
                            (
                                (SELECT c.rank FROM current c
                                WHERE c.id = CASE 
                                    WHEN u.id = $1 THEN $2
                                    ELSE $1
                                END)
                                - u.rank
                            ) / 400.0
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
            WHERE u.id IN ($1, $2);
